product.description:
Chrome Parallel Cards
Ultra-rare Chrome and Opal Chrome pattern Topps NOW® parallels will unlock for cards with large print runs at specific tiers as additional lucky parallels:
50,000+ Print Run: Look for Chrome parallels /99 and /50 + lower parallel structure.
100,000+ Print Run: Look for Chrome parallels /25, /10, /5 and 1/1 SuperFractor + lower parallel structure.
250,000+ Print Run: Look for Opal Chrome parallels /50, /25, /10 and /5 + lower parallel structure.
500,000+ Print Run: Look for 1/1 White OpalFractor Chrome + lower parallel structure
Capturing all the excitement of UEFA Nations League - Topps NOW® brings the biggest moments directly to your collection!
Your Hero. Your Team. Your Moment. ™
Topps NOW® celebrates the greatest moments... as they happen! Only available at Topps.com.
Please note that orders of multiple print on demand products will be consolidated in your delivery. The latest timer expiry will be used for the above shipping times. If you order a print on demand product with a stock item (retail product) this will be fulfilled from different facilities and the order may split.
